🚀 Past 24h — Top 7 (by impact)

1️⃣ Extreme Fear + BTC still above $87K — market refuses to die

Global crypto cap sits around $3.0T; BTC grinds sideways near $87–88K while multiple trad markets are closed for Christmas.  

2️⃣ Altcoin Season Index collapses to 17 — BTC season confirmed

CoinMarketCap’s Altcoin Season Index is now 17, down from 18 yesterday and far from the 75+ “altseason” threshold.  

3️⃣ NFT market hits 2025 low — year-end rally totally rug-pulled

New data shows NFT total market cap only ~$2.5B, down ~72% from the January peak of $9.2B.  

Weekly NFT sales have been stuck under $70M, unique buyers down from ~180K to ~130K, sellers under 100K.  

4️⃣ Bitcoin RSI flashing possible bear market — 1–2 months are critical

Binance cites CryptoQuant research: BTC has dropped ~19.7% over 3 months and monthly RSI has slipped below its 12-month average for the first time in this cycle.  

5️⃣ Trump-world crypto empire: WLFI ecosystem flexes multi-billion footprint

Binance reports Trump family–linked project WLFI announcing its USD1 stablecoin side has crossed $3B market cap, while WLFI itself trades around $0.137.  

6️⃣ Regulatory clamp: EU tax, Philippines blocks CEX, HK tightens VA rules

KuCoin’s daily report highlights DAC8 taking effect in the EU, increasing tax reporting obligations on crypto.  

7️⃣ Ethereum & whales under pressure — warning signs pile up

Fresh analysis calls out four warning signals that ETH’s price recovery may stall into late December (weak on-chain activity, fading L2 growth, ETF flow fragility, and competitive L1 pressure).

data.raw_text: The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) began the rehabilitation of EDSA on Christmas Eve, starting at 11 PM on Wednesday, as the department advised motorists “to use other roads to avoid getting caught in possible slow-moving traffic.” Portions of the innermost lanes of EDSA reserved for the EDSA Bus Carousel, particularly near Roxas Boulevard, have been excavated, according to radio and television reports. The concrete barriers used for the busway were moved to the next lane. https://t.co/22Qj1idWRJ

BABALA: Ulat patungkol sa aksidente. 

4 NASAWI MATAPOS MAHULOG ANG BUS SA BANGIN

DEVELOPING STORY: Apat ang kumpirmadong nasawi matapos mahulog ang isang pampasaherong bus sa bangin sa Andaya Highway, Magais 1, Del Gallego, Camarines Sur, bandang 2 AM ngayong Biyernes, Disyembre 26, 2025.

Galing sa Quezon City at patungong Sorsogon ang bus na lulan ng 25 pasahero at dalawang driver.

Nagpapatuloy ang retrieval operation para sa dalawang labi na hindi pa nakukuha. | via Peewee Bacuño/Stringer
